visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: small centered icon (~60px) or full-bleed top photo

contentPattern: One row per card. Cell 1: optional image (an icon up to ~160px intrinsic width renders as a centered 60px icon; larger images render full-width on top). Cell 2: H3 title, description paragraphs and/or lists, optional link (plain link, or a YouTube URL for a video). Empty paragraphs are dropped. Column count follows the number of cards (1, 2, 3, or 4).
reuseGuidance: Use for teaser tiles/cards (icon or photo + title + text + optional link) that sit side by side and wrap. Use columns-media for image/text rows instead.
